title: Holder Refund Release Amount and Late Interest
content:
**Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda — computation of a refund released to the holder**

1. **Refund due.** The holder release pays the refund due, which is the amount of the refund calculation entry on the waiver's ledger.
2. **Effective date.** The effective date of the waiver's ending, by termination or by cancellation, is the waiver's closing date, or the release date where the waiver carries none.
3. **Late window.** The late window of a holder release starts on the effective date of the waiver's ending.
4. **Holder late interest.** Where the holder release is made more than the refund payment period of the waiver's tier (calendar days) after the late window starts, holder late interest is added on the refund due at 0.05 a year (5 percent) for each calendar day past that period after the window start, counted on a 365-day year and rounded half up to the cent.
5. **Release amount.** The holder release amount is the refund due plus the holder late interest, rounded half up to the cent.
6. **No release.** A holder release is not made for a refund due of 0.00, and it is made only on a waiver whose loan payoff date is on file; for any other waiver the holder release amount is 0.00.

The refund payment period is the figure shown for the waiver's tier in the cancellation and refund terms of the Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda.

## Input, judgement, output

| Input | Judgement | Output |
|---|---|---|
| Release on or before the last day of the refund payment period after the window start | No late days | Release amount equals the refund due |
| Release later than that | Late days are the days past the period | Interest at 0.05 a year on the refund due, rounded to the cent, added |
| Refund due 0.00 | — | No release |

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A terminated waiver closes on Day 0 with a refund calculation entry of 318.62; the tier's refund payment period is 30 days and the release is made on Day 56. Late days are 56 less 30, which is 26. Interest is 318.62 times 0.05 times 26, divided by 365, which is 1.1348…, rounded half up to 1.13. The release amount is 318.62 plus 1.13, which is 319.75.
